content: Camillian Hospital, also known as San Camillo Hospital, is a small private hospital located in the Watthana district of Bangkok, Thailand. It was established by Catholic missionaries known as the Camillians. The hospital provides both general medical services and specialized care facilities. The institution is managed by the Saint Camillus Foundation of Thailand and operates various charity programs aimed at providing medical treatment to underprivileged and low-income patients. In response to the 2004 tsunami disaster in Thailand, the staff of Camillian Hospital played a significant role in relief efforts. They established mobile clinics to deliver medical care to survivors of the disaster.
